issues.description: The problem statement instructs students to mark the end of the main loop with the label 'loop_end' (problem_statement.md lines 21-22). The solution implementation defines a different label name 'end_loop' (solution_repository/helloWorld.asm line 17). The template (template_repository/helloWorld.asm, within main at lines 8-18) does not include any loop-end label to demonstrate where to place it. This inconsistent identifier naming across artifacts (problem statement vs. solution) and the missing example label in the template can confuse students about the exact label to add and may cause mismatches with automated checks or grading that expect a specific label name.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the label name consistent across all artifacts and show its intended location in the template. Preferred fix: rename the label in solution_repository/helloWorld.asm from 'end_loop' to 'loop_end' and add the 'loop_end:' label in template_repository/helloWorld.asm immediately before the final 'ret' (around main's end). Alternatively, update the problem statement to request 'end_loop' instead of 'loop_end'. Ensure any automated tests or grading scripts are updated to expect the chosen label name.
